title: eval-harness: add per-prompt regression CI hook and quality gating enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
ci_status: pass (flaky test fixed, final run passed)
description:
Motivation: We need per-prompt regression checks in the eval-harness CI to catch quality regressions introduced by model swaps, tokenization changes, or prompt refactors. This PR introduces a lightweight CI hook that runs per-prompt evals on a small, representative subset and enforces configurable quality gates.

Summary of changes: Added a new CI hook (ci/workflows/eval-harness.yml) that triggers a per-prompt eval job on PRs touching model-serving or prompt sets. Implemented eval-harness/ci/per_prompt_hook.py which orchestrates per-prompt runs, fetches recent golden outputs, computes configured metrics (exact-match, BLEU, embedding-sim), and compares against thresholds defined in eval-harness/config/gating.yaml. Added unit and integration tests under tests/eval/, plus small adapter in redwood-ci to cache golden outputs to reduce run time. Updated docs in docs/eval-harness/ci.md with configuration and troubleshooting.

Compatibility & rollout: The hook is opt-in via a new repo-level label (run-eval-harness) and enabled for the redwood repo by default in a shadow mode (reports only) for two weeks after merge. Gating thresholds are configurable per-prompt-set and fallback to global defaults. No breaking changes to existing eval APIs.

Testing: Added pytest unit tests covering metric computations and threshold logic, integration tests that run a tiny model shim to validate end-to-end behavior, and a GH Actions matrix to validate runner images. CI initially failed due to a flaky timing assumption in tests; fixed by adding deterministic seeding and a small wait-retry for ephemeral resources. Final CI run passed.

Notes: This PR focuses on making prompt-level regressions visible earlier and giving teams the ability to opt into strict gating. Follow-ups will add richer metrics (ROUGE, human-eval hooks) and dashboards for historical regressions.
commits: Initial implementation of per-prompt CI hook (per_prompt_hook.py, wiring in eval-harness)

Docs: CI guide and runbooks for prompt regression checks
Fix flaky tests (seed RNG + retry), update thresholds after reviewer feedback

release_notes:
- Add per-prompt regression CI hook to detect prompt-set quality regressions early.
- Introduce configurable quality gating at per-prompt-set and global levels.
- Add unit and integration tests and CI workflow for eval-harness.
- No breaking changes; opt-in shadow mode enabled by default for 2 weeks.
